full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, in short, are that Harkumar Banik was the original owner of 0.34 acre of the land of suit Settlement Khatian No.2352. He remaining as the owner in possession in the said land, died leaving behind two sons namely, Rawsraj Banik and Ashwani Kumar Banik and each of them inherited 0.17 acre of land out of said 0.34 of land; thereafter, Ashwani Kumar Banik sold 0.8 acre of land by registered deed dated 06.06.1957 and by another registered deed dated 05.06.1957 sold0.9 acre of land in favour of Rawsraj Banik and handed over possession in his favour who, thus, became owner in the said 0.34 acre of land and the land was recorded in his name in S.A. Khatian; that thereafter, Rawsraj Banik died leaving behind two sons namely, Krishna Chandra Banik and Balaram Banik and both sons were enjoying the land as joint property of the family, Balaram Banik being the elder brother was the Karta of joint family used to perform all acts in the interest of their joint family Balaram alone did never claimed the property and he alone also did not possess the same. Balram as the elder brother and Karta of the joint family purchased the land in his name out of the income of joint property; that the plaintiff purchased 0.03 acre land from suit S.A. Khatian No. 1997 by registered kabala dated 15.12.1977 out of income of joint family in the name of the plaintiff and b) way of another deed, 0.06 acre of land of they said Khatian No. 1997 was purchased in the name of Balaram out of Joint income of the family; thus the plaintiff and Balaram purchased aforesaid 0.09 acre of land by their joint income and constructed building therein and 0.83/4 acre of land of suit Khatian No.5314 was purchased in the name of plaintiff by two deeds dated 17.08.1981 and 11.01.1982 respectively and 0.8314 acre of land was purchased in the name of Balaram. Banik by two deeds dated 15.1 1.1980 and 11.11.1982 out of their joint income and accordingly, they had been jointly possessing the same; that Mondan Mohan was their full brother, his share has been purchased in the name of Balaram by registered deed dated 02.08.1974 from joint income of the plaintiff and Balaram. The plaintiff and Balaram use to carry joint business. The plaintiff also has equally share of the money deposited in the Bank by Balaram, thus the plaintiff and Balaram were the owner in 50% share of the suit property. Balaram died on 11 Baishak, 1396 B.S. leaving behind the defendant Nos. 1- 4 3 as his only heirs. After his death the plaintiff demanded the amicable partition of the suit property and having failed the plaintiff filed the suit.
